decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the core spraying business, the firm is likely to continue backing it because engineering investment is already made and disappointing early traction can still be interpreted as a temporary market-development issue.
This product is very close to the established offer and was given its own webpage, so sunk development effort and visible commitment make management unlikely to withdraw it quickly.
Because it builds on the firm's existing pump and material-handling capabilities, management would tend to retain it and justify the launch rather than reverse course after only about a year.
The firm has publicly highlighted it with its own page and it also fits the stated move toward more future-oriented and interoperable solutions, which strengthens commitment to keep it on the market.
